lines.text: Many learners say: If I am you, I would tell her.
Better: If I were you, I would tell her.
The second! If I were you, I would go.

data.wrong: If I am you, I would tell her.
data.right: If I were you, I would tell her.

options: If I am you, I would go.
If I were you, I would go.

native.hook: “如果我是你”要说 If I were you！
native.tip: 中文说“如果我是你”，但英语要用 were：“If I were you”，不用 am。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “If I am you, I would tell her.”😅 英语里想象的情况要说 were：“If I were you, I would tell her.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“If I were you, I would tell her.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: In Chinese you say “if I am you,” but English uses “were,” not “am.”
en.caption: Do you say “If I am you, I would tell her.” 😅 For an imagined situation, English uses “were”: “If I were you, I would tell her.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
